task_name: World 113 Task A  -  State Sales Tax Portal Cross-Quarter Misposting, Transposition Credit & Statutory Cadence

rubric.description: Verifies that every Q3 2026 month at Palisades NJ stayed under the $2,200.00 monthly benchmark ($2,190.67 July, $2,160.15 August, and $1,735.64 September, with $6,070.46 Q3 Form ST-50 total tax due after the Q3 TapMango adjustment).
Identifies that TXN-26232 ($2,242.24 paid on 2026-08-21 for July ST-51) contained a $100.20 transposition overpayment above July's $2,142.04 POS tax collected and was credited in full against Q3.

Explains that the $3,828.22 Q3 ST-50 balance paid on TXN-26294 (2026-10-21) equals $6,070.46 total Q3 tax less the $2,242.24 July credit, covering two months combined ($3,879.79 net for August + September less the July overpayment) because no August ST-51 was paid in September.
Reconciles Q1 2026 ($4,585.02 calculated vs. $4,585.03 paid) and Q2 2026 ($6,564.21 calculated vs. $6,564.25 paid) within pennies ($0.01 in Q1 and $0.04 in Q2).

Identifies that TXN-26051 ($1,525.45 paid on 2026-02-23 for January) was misposted to Q2 2026 on the NJ portal, leaving only TXN-26079 ($1,263.07) in Q1 and forcing TXN-26107 (2026-04-20 Q1 return) to pay $3,321.96 at once for January + March.

Identifies that the $1,525.45 cross-quarter credit sitting in Q2 reduced TXN-26139 (2026-05-20) to $471.02 (totalling $1,996.47 for April), followed by TXN-26169 ($2,316.65) and TXN-26201 ($2,251.13).

Proves that 2025 full-year Palisades NJ sales tax of $25,106.98 (on $497,461.48 POS net sales) is below New Jersey's $30,000.00 prior-year threshold (N.J.A.C. 18:24-11.2) for mandatory monthly ST-51 prepayments.

Requires 3-way reconciliation across POS calculated tax, bank EFT debits, and state portal period-detail credits rather than matching by bank cash date alone, and transitions the entity to quarterly-only ST-50 filing going forward.

prompt: Review the Q2 and Q3 2026 NY ST-100 and NJ ST-50/ST-51 sales tax schedules, POS gross/exempt sales extracts, and bank ACH confirmations in `state_sales_tax_portal_and_marketplace_pos_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile the QBO sales tax liability balance and compute the exact Q3 2026 NJ ST-50 net balance due.
gold_output:
World 113 Task A  -  State Sales Tax Portal Cross-Quarter Misposting, Transposition Credit & Statutory Cadence:
1. Q3 2026 Monthly Breakdown vs. $2,200.00 Benchmark: Every Q3 month stayed under $2,200.00 ($2,190.67 July on TXN-26232, $2,160.15 August, and $1,735.64 September = $6,070.46 total Q3 tax due; August + September combined calculated tax = $3,879.79). On 2026-08-21, TXN-26232 paid $2,242.24 for July ST-51 (a $100.20 transposition overpayment above July's $2,142.04 POS tax collected, credited in full to Q3), and no August ST-51 was paid in September, leaving $3,828.22 ($6,070.46 - $2,242.24) paid on TXN-26294 (2026-10-21) for August + September combined.
2. 3-Way Portal vs. Bank vs. POS Tie-Out (Q1 & Q2 2026): Q1 calculated tax of $4,585.02 ties to $4,585.03 paid ($0.01 rounding), and Q2 calculated tax of $6,564.21 ties to $6,564.25 paid ($0.04 rounding). TXN-26051 ($1,525.45 on 2026-02-23 for January) was misposted to Q2 2026 on the NJ portal, leaving only TXN-26079 ($1,263.07) in Q1 so TXN-26107 (2026-04-20) paid $3,321.96 at once for January + March. In Q2, that $1,525.45 credit reduced TXN-26139 (2026-05-20) to $471.02 ($1,996.47 total for April), followed by TXN-26169 ($2,316.65) and TXN-26201 ($2,251.13).
3. Statutory Quarterly Cadence (N.J.A.C. 18:24-11.2): Full-year 2025 Palisades NJ tax was $25,106.98 on $497,461.48 POS net sales, below the $30,000.00 threshold for mandatory monthly ST-51 prepayments, so the entity transitions to quarterly-only ST-50 filing going forward.
